chemistry-killer-01.title: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic (Inquiry)
chemistry-killer-01.topic: Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic (Inquiry)
chemistry-killer-01.goal: Analyze the principles of Ukulondolozwa kobunzima, umlinganiselo ongatshintshiyo, i-exothermic ne-endothermic (Inquiry) and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
chemistry-killer-01.material:
Impuphu yekopolo (Cu) itshiswa nge-oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) kwisikhongozeli esivaliweyo ukwenza i-copper(II) oxide ($\mathrm{CuO}$). Kuyo yonke imifuniselo isikhongozeli sinee-2.0 g ze-$\mathrm{O_2}$, kwaye intsabela yi-$\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$. Ubunzima be-CuO obwenziweyo bu:
(A) Cu 4.0 g -> CuO 5.0 g
(B) Cu 8.0 g -> CuO 10.0 g
(C) Cu 12.0 g -> CuO 10.0 g
Umthetho wemilinganiselo echanekileyo uyasebenza phantsi kweemeko ezifanayo. Kwisikhongozeli esifanayo, i-14.0 g ye-Cu kunye ne-4.0 g ye-$\mathrm{O_2}$ zisabelisa de enye isabelayo iphele. Sesiphi isiphumo esichanekileyo?

Impuphu yekopolo (Cu) itshiswa nge-oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) kwisikhongozeli esivaliweyo ukwenza i-copper(II) oxide ($\mathrm{CuO}$). Kuyo yonke imifuniselo isikhongozeli sinee-2.0 g ze-$\mathrm{O_2}$, kwaye intsabela yi-$\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$. Ubunzima be-CuO obwenziweyo bu:
(A) Cu 4.0 g -> CuO 5.0 g
(B) Cu 8.0 g -> CuO 10.0 g
(C) Cu 12.0 g -> CuO 10.0 g
Umthetho wemilinganiselo echanekileyo uyasebenza phantsi kweemeko ezifanayo. Kwisikhongozeli esifanayo, i-14.0 g ye-Cu kunye ne-4.0 g ye-$\mathrm{O_2}$ zisabelisa de enye isabelayo iphele. Sesiphi isiphumo esichanekileyo?
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Kwi-(C), ukongeza i-Cu akunyusi i-CuO ngaphezu kwe-10.0 g, ngoko yonke i-2.0 g ye-$\mathrm{O_2}$ yasabela: CuO 10.0 g = Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g, oko kukuthi Cu:O = 4:1. (Khangela: kwi-(A) Cu 4.0 g + O 1.0 g = 5.0 g kushiyeke i-O; kwi-(B) Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g = 10.0 g ngqo; kwi-(C) kushiyeke i-Cu eyi-4.0 g.)
Inyathelo 2: I-O efunekayo kwi-14.0 g ye-Cu = $14.0 \times \frac{1}{4} = 3.5$ g. Kuba kunikezelwe i-4.0 g ye-$\mathrm{O_2}$, yonke i-Cu iyasabela kwaye i-$\mathrm{O_2}$ g ye-$4.0-3.5=0.5$ iyashiyeka.
Inyathelo 3: I-CuO eyenziweyo = 14.0 + 3.5 = 17.5 g (Cu:O:CuO = 4:1:5).
Iimpendulo: a (CuO 17.5 g, $\mathrm{O_2}$ 0.5 g eshiyekileyo). (Ezinye ezingachanekanga: i-18.0 g yongeza i-O engasabelanga; i-20.0 g ibalwa kwi-4.0 g ye-O ingahoyi ukuba i-Cu iyaphela.)
